info.title: PolyBackTest API
info.description: PolyBackTest provides comprehensive, real-time access to prediction market data and historical snapshots. Build trading strategies, perform backtesting, and analyze market movements with our powerful REST API.

get.description:
List all markets with pagination.

Returns markets sorted by start_time descending (newest first).

metadata.title: List All Markets
metadata.description: Retrieve a paginated list of prediction markets with optional filtering

x-mint.content:
## Overview

This endpoint returns all available prediction markets. Use the filtering parameters to narrow down results by market type or resolution status.

<Note>Markets are sorted by start time in descending order, so you'll see the newest markets first.</Note>

<Info>Learn how to query effectively using time filters and pagination limits in our [Fetching Data & Pagination](/fetching-data) guide.</Info>

<Info>Check the [Available Data & Markets](/available-data) guide to see which market types are supported for each coin.</Info>

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Cryptocurrency to query. **MANDATORY**: Supported coins include btc, eth. New coins added as they become available.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Filter markets starting after this time — ms epoch or ISO8601

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Filter markets starting before this time — ms epoch or ISO8601

metadata.title: Get Market By Slug
metadata.description: Retrieve market details using a human-readable slug identifier

x-mint.content:
## Slug Format

Market slugs follow a consistent naming pattern based on the market type and timing.

**Examples:**
- `btc-updown-24h-2026-01-01`
- `btc-updown-1hr-2026-01-01-09`

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Cryptocurrency to query. **MANDATORY**: Supported coins include btc, eth. New coins added as they become available.

get.description:
Get snapshots for a market with pagination.

Returns snapshots sorted by time ascending (oldest first).
Maximum limit is 1000 snapshots per request.

By default, include_orderbook=false for lower-latency, lighter responses. Set include_orderbook=true when you need full orderbook depth.

metadata.title: Get Market Snapshots
metadata.description: Retrieve paginated historical snapshots for backtesting and analysis

x-mint.content:
## Snapshot Data

Snapshots capture the market state at regular intervals, including:
- **Price data**: Bid/ask prices for UP and DOWN tokens
- **Order book**: Full order book depth at capture time
- **BTC price**: Bitcoin price at snapshot time

<Info>Orderbooks are not returned by default (`include_orderbook=false`). Set `include_orderbook=true` when you need full orderbook depth.</Info>

<Tip>Use `start_time` and `end_time` filters to focus on specific time windows for backtesting.</Tip>

<Info>Learn how to query effectively using time filters and pagination limits in our [Fetching Data & Pagination](/fetching-data) guide.</Info>

<Info>Check the [Available Data & Markets](/available-data) guide to see which market types are supported for each coin.</Info>

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Cryptocurrency to query. **MANDATORY**: Supported coins include btc, eth. New coins added as they become available.

parameters.name: include_orderbook
parameters.description: Include full orderbook JSON in each snapshot. Default: false. Set include_orderbook=true when you need full orderbook depth.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Filter snapshots after this time — ms epoch or ISO8601

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Filter snapshots before this time — ms epoch or ISO8601

get.description:
Get the closest snapshot to a specific timestamp.

Returns the snapshot closest to the given timestamp, but only if it's within ±2 seconds. Returns 404 if no snapshot is found within that range.

Note: Snapshots are always returned as an array (containing 0 or 1 element).

metadata.title: Get Snapshot At Timestamp
metadata.description: Find the exact market state at a specific point in time

x-mint.content:
## Precision Lookup

This endpoint finds the closest snapshot within a **±2 second tolerance** of your target timestamp. Perfect for:
- Point-in-time analysis
- Correlating with external events
- Backtesting trade entries/exits

<Warning>Returns 404 if no snapshot exists within the 2-second tolerance window.</Warning>

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Cryptocurrency to query. **MANDATORY**: Supported coins include btc, eth. New coins added as they become available.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Target timestamp — ms epoch or ISO8601

404.description: No snapshot found within ±2 seconds of timestamp

get.description:

<Info>Learn how to query effectively using time filters and pagination limits in our [Fetching Data & Pagination](/fetching-data) guide.</Info>

parameters.description: Cryptocurrency to query. **MANDATORY**: Supported coins include btc, eth. New coins added as they become available.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End timestamp (ms epoch or ISO8601, default: now)
